feedback.problem:
Let $T=UV.$ What is the value of ${t}_{41}$, if

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & -1 \\ -2 & 2 & 10 \\ -3 & 1 & -1 \\ -5 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}],\,V=[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 & -2 \\ -1 & 10 & -1 \\ -1 & 20 & -1\end{aligned}]?
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Multiplying the $4$th row of $U$ by the $1$st column in $V$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{t}_{41} & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & -1 \\ -2 & 2 & 10 \\ -3 & 1 & -1 \\ -5 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 & -2 \\ -1 & 10 & -1 \\ -1 & 20 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-5 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =(-5)\cdot (-2)+3\cdot (-1)+10\cdot (-1) \\  & =10-3-10 \\  & =-3.\end{aligned}
$$
